description: Fetch a single hydrated audio post. Tenancy-scoped: the calling application's service credential establishes which tenant is read, and a post belonging to another tenant is indistinguishable from one that does not exist.

main.description: Returns the hydrated view of one post. The acting actor, if the caller asserts one, determines the `viewer` state; a viewer-less read returns the public projection.

id.description: The post's record key (rkey) — the last segment of its at:// URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No post with this key in the caller's tenancy. Also the answer for a post that exists in another tenancy.
